items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12

ctx.x: Yes. Well, I've learned music since I've been here. But I've only finished a field and I just pick up a few chords and sing with the chords that I play behind. What instrument is that now? It's guitar. Guitar. Now, what kind of music do you remember hearing when you were a kid over there in Alabama? Well, they have all instruments. I live in the neighborhood of Tuskegee Institute and they have all the sax perform, guitar, trumpet, piano. You didn't hear anything like this over there? No, no more than after I've…
